Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1822. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary to compound_structures (INNER JOIN for canonical_smiles). Filter: standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value is not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000.
